# Results

This directory contains experimental outputs generated by the Multichannel Biomedical Signal Classification pipeline.

---

## Overview

The results directory stores evaluation outputs produced after training and testing machine learning models.

Generated outputs may include:

- Classification accuracy
- Confusion matrix
- Classification report
- Evaluation summaries

---

## Generated Files

Example output structure:

```text
results/

├── accuracy.txt

├── confusion_matrix.csv

└── classification_report.txt
```

---

## Evaluation Metrics

The evaluation module calculates:

- Accuracy
- Confusion Matrix
- Classification Report

The implementation is available at:

```text
src/evaluation/metrics.py
```

---

## Result Generation

Results are generated automatically after model evaluation using the evaluation pipeline.

Main workflow:

```text
Model Prediction

        ↓

Evaluation Module

        ↓

Saved Results
```

---

## Notes

This repository currently contains the experimental framework and result generation pipeline.

Final experimental results and visualization files can be added after completing final training experiments.
